items.title: feat(config): support ${VAR:-default} in config env substitution (#15…
items.summary: feat(config): support ${VAR:-default} in config env substitution (#155164) Support inline environment defaults when a variable is unset or empty, using the same token grammar for substitution and authored config write-back. Preserve escapes, unsupported forms, and escaped-reference activation guards. Include regression coverage and user documentation. This intentionally changes previously literal fallback-shaped values on upgrade. Operators preserving such an existing Gateway credential can supply its exact bytes through OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN, remove the inline token, and retain token mode; isolated production loader/writeback/auth-boundary proof verifies that transition. Closes #149551 Co-authored-by: Mitchell Etzel Co-authored-by: jalehman

items.title: fix(ci): keep large test inventories on Git
items.summary: fix(ci): keep large test inventories on Git The repository's Git file list exceeds Node's default 1 MiB subprocess buffer. ENOBUFS sent test discovery into its filesystem fallback, which traversed generated Vitest caches and raced their replacement with ENOENT. Move the existing 16 MiB inventory limit to the listing owner, share it with the other selectors, and retain it in the wrapper's source closure. A real 6,000-entry Git index regression fails before the fix and preserves the complete tracked inventory afterward without admitting generated files. It costs 244 ms of test time and 2.51 s wall time with one worker. Linux proof passed the original owner file 20 times and its complete CI shard three times, plus 1,604 owner and sibling tests.

items.title: OpenAI公布GPT-6 Sol、Luna，價格較前代降低一半
items.summary: 繼頂級的Astra後，OpenAI周二（9/22）宣布GPT-6 Sol及輕量模型GPT-6 Luna，成為GPT-6家族最新成員。 OpenAI隨著快取和推論能力的提升，使其得以更低成本提供強大模型功能，Sol和Luna的API價格皆較GPT-5.6版降一半。其中Sol每百萬token輸入/輸出價格由4/20美元降為2/10美元，Luna則從0.2/1.2降為0.1和0.5美元。

items.title: 針對CRA開源責任，OpenSSF以三類角色協助開源社群判斷義務
items.summary: 歐盟《網路韌性法案》（CRA）陸續進入實施階段，不同開源軟體參與者究竟需要承擔哪些責任，也成為開源社群關注的問題。開源安全基金會（OpenSSF）9月15日推出「Grow CRA Readiness」CRA準備指南，協助開源社群判斷自身義務，依三種角色提供相應的準備路徑與資源。
